sock.description: Unix socket path to bind SWANK server to (e.g., "/tmp/slime.sock"). If empty, falls back to TCP port.

port.description: TCP port for SWANK server when `sock` is empty.

start_server.description: Whether to automatically start the SWANK server on Lisp startup.

pid_file.description: Path to write the PID file (e.g., "/var/run/swank.pid"). Use 'nil' to disable.

log_output.description: Path to log SWANK output, or 'nil' to disable logging.

use_dedicated_output_stream.description: Use a dedicated output stream for slime-output-buffer communication (improves reliability).

use_quicklisp.description: Enable Quicklisp integration in SWANK (e.g., for ASDF load operations).

max_listener_threads.description: Maximum number of listener threads. Set to `null` to use default (usually 8).

contribs.description: List of SWANK contrib modules to load (as strings, e.g., "swank-asdf", "swank-arglists").

items.description: Name of a SWANK contrib module (without .lisp extension).

extra_setup.description: Additional S-expression forms to evaluate at SWANK startup (e.g., to set custom variables or hooks).

items.description: A valid Lisp S-expression to be written into the config as-is (no escaping).
